option.commonObjectives.help: One Common Objective card of each type is put into play. For your first game, the rulebook suggests playing without them.
option.soloDifficulty.1.help: 1 Common Objective card, which you must complete to win.
option.soloDifficulty.2.help: 2 Common Objective cards of different types, which you must complete to win.
option.soloDifficulty.3.help: 3 Common Objective cards, one of each type, which you must complete to win.
